newsitem.title: USA: SONUS accepted for filing on EchoGen.
newsitem.headline: SONUS accepted for filing on EchoGen.

text.p: Sonus Pharmaceuticals Inc announced it had gained acceptance for filing of a Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) from the European Medicines Evaluation Agency (EMEA) for EchoGen(R), a fluorocarbon-based ultrasound contrast agent.
EchoGen(R) was developed to enhance the clinical utility, diagnostic accuracy and cost-effectiveness of ultrasound procedures in radiology and cardiology.
Acceptance means a preliminary review determined the filing contained the information and studies required by the regulations.
